description: This file provides an API for handling audio recording in a web application, including starting, stopping, canceling recordings, and managing recording controls and elapsed time display.

methods.name: startAudioRecording
methods.description: Initiates audio recording, handles success and error cases, and updates UI controls.

methods.name: stopAudioRecording
methods.description: Stops the ongoing audio recording and optionally adds the recorded blob to previews.

methods.name: cancelAudioRecording
methods.description: Cancels the current audio recording and updates UI controls.
